# SelectField

A styled native (sn-select) for choosing one option from a short, fixed list.

`SongNodes.SelectField` · Inputs

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.SelectField label="…" options={…} value="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.SelectField" label="…" options="{{…}}" value="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (SelectFieldProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` * | `string` | Visible label. |
| `options` * | `{ value: string; label: string }[]` | Options (keep under about 15; otherwise use a combobox). |
| `value` * | `string` | Selected value; "" for the neutral first option ("Any show"). |
| `onChange` * | `(value: string) => void` | Change handler. |
| `help` | `string` | Help text. |
| `error` | `string` | Error message. |
| `inline` | `boolean` | Label beside the select, 32px tall, for toolbars ("Sort by"). |
| `disabledReason` | `string` | Disabled with a reason in the help line. |
